plugins.name: dumb-down
plugins.description: Re-explain the previous response (or a specified topic) in plainer language — ELI30-but-tired.

plugins.name: google-style
plugins.description: Speak and write in Google developer documentation style for the rest of the session.

plugins.name: kaomoji
plugins.description: Express yourself with kaomoji — Japanese-style text emoticons — for the rest of the session.

plugins.name: step-back
plugins.description: Pause hands-on work and reassess an area from a higher level — ideal architecture vs. accrued friction.

plugins.name: three-designs
plugins.description: Spawn 3 parallel sub-agents to produce 3 radically different design solutions, each using a distinct mental model.

plugins.name: two-claudes
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan by grilling it with codebase access and sending each question to an independent expert agent for fresh perspective.

plugins.name: wrap-up
plugins.description: End-of-session wrap-up: save durable knowledge to memory, then commit the session's code changes in clean, scoped commits.
